method_findings.repeat_swap-n32: Target-only repeated swaps reselect verbatim source bullets from each site's own 32 samples using its own activation; no control activation or external factual evidence enters selection. Final text changes at 2342/19435 sites (12.0504%), preserves bullet count at every site, and raises mean paired reconstruction FVE by 0.0001766641 (0.0176664 percentage points) versus plain pool, without establishing prose truth. Native endpoints are Hallucination (chat) 2615/5552 contradictions versus parent 2621/5555, Multihop (multi-token) 41/100 versus 41/100, Chained intermediates 51/120 versus 53/120, and Role-bound association 84/100 versus 81/100; the original released Oracle Lens is respectively 2648/5560, 34/100, 59/120, 78/100. Parent-relative simultaneous 95% paired delta intervals are Hall [-0.0085540,0.0069025], chains [-0.0507702,0.0174368], roles [-0.0238942,0.0838942]; multihop has identical question outcomes, a pointwise [0,0] interval and no simultaneous interval due zero variation, which is not robust zero uncertainty. The joint family declares 44 comparisons with 40 nondegenerate, using 10000 whole-group bootstrap draws; all 469 questions were previously inspected, and outcome-selected examples are illustrative rather than frequency estimates. Inspected cases show real bridge-name redistribution and intermediate loss alongside mixed role cues and judge sensitivity: retained wrong spans often survive Hall label changes, role judgments vary in accepting wrong names, and the sole same-text retained-evidence difference here is timestamp metadata. Four-bullet original, raw original and actual-parent references must stay distinct; cached_parent_fallback prune actions are not final output deletions.
